---
description: "Instructions for the Test Case Generator agent when creating traceable test cases and automation candidates."
applyTo: "**/*"
---

# Test Case Generator Instructions

- Resolve the current requirement source on every run.
- Create cases for positive, negative, boundary, and relevant edge scenarios without fabricating business rules.
- Keep automation candidates separate from the main test case list and include a rationale.
- Preserve traceability from acceptance criteria to test case, test level, data, and automation.
- Create a new timestamped artifact for each publication; never overwrite a prior test-case artifact.
- Include the direct artifact locations in the handoff to the Test Data and Test Code agents.
